title: New Faces on Austin Planning Board
summary:
*   A special meeting was called specifically to appoint new members to the city's Planning Commission.
*   W. A. Wroe, Edgar Jackson, and Barton D. (Pat) Riley were appointed to serve on the commission until June 1964.
*   The city acknowledged and expressed appreciation for the service of two resigning Planning Commission members.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
June 25, 1962
11:00 Α.Μ.
Council Chamber, City Hall
614
The meeting was called to order with Mayor Palmer presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Absent: None MAYOR PALMER
announced this was a Special Meeting called for the purpose of appointing members to the
Planning Commission for terms to extend to June 1, 1964.
Councilman Shanks moved that the Council appoint the following to serve as members of the
Planning Commission for terms extending until June 1, 1964:
MR. W. A. WROE
MR. EDGAR JACKSON
MR. BARTON D. (PAT) RILEY
The motion, seconded by Councilman Perry, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Noes: None The Council noted with regrets
the resignations of MR. FRED BARKLEY and MR. NOBLE DOSS and expressed appreciation for
their past services on the Planning Commission.
There being no further business, Councilman White moved that the Council adjourn. The
motion, seconded by Councilman Shanks, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Armstrong, Perry, Shanks, White, Mayor Palmer Noes: None
